entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-06
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • AccidentalEntityType error generated on upgrade to EFCore 10 #37457
  • EF Core incorrectly tracks computed property as modified with wrong original value when using navigation-based property #37455

Closed

  • How to implement transactional outbox - which interceptors to use? #37211
  • Wrong blob data returned in select statement #34762
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite incorrectly adds to RecordsAffected for additional statements #35642
    11.0.0
  • IReadOnlySet<T>.Contains not translated into parameterized query #37081
    11.0.0
  • IReadOnlyCollection cannot be used with Contains Query #36262
    11.0.0
  • Error querying on complex type whose container is mapped to a table and a view #34706
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Remove EFCore.Analyzers.nuspec and use MSBuild packaging #37456
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37454

Merged

  • [release/10.0] Fix ArgumentOutOfRangeException for entities with shadow properties and nullable complex types with discriminators #37394
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.3
  • [release/10.0] Fix deletion of entities with non-empty complex collection #37382
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.3
  • Fix RecordsAffected incorrectly accumulating counts from DDL statements #37397
  • Fix handling of Contains on IReadOnlySet and custom IReadOnlyCollection. #37390
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0' => 'release/10.0' #37453
  • Add test covering querying of complex type on view #37364
  • Clean up {SqlServer,Sqlite}SqlTranslatingExpressionVisitor #37450

Updated

  • [release/10.0] Fix migration discovery when [DbContext] is only on base class #37437
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.3
  • Add runtime migration creation and application #37415
    community-contribution
  • Cosmos: Complex properties binding #37400
    community-contribution
  • Fix null check optimization for IQueryable/DbSet types in LINQ queries #36986
  • Translate COALESCE as ISNULL in more cases #35986
    community-contribution
  • Allow using foreign keys in Dataverse reverse engineering #34689
    community-contribution
  • Pass read only span to SQLite raw to avoid allocation #37436
    community-contribution
